blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Allowing the proposal to let the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte give a limited rebuttal on the three withdrawn impeachment articles would be “a complete waste of time and resources of the court and everyone involved.” Lawyer Benjamin Tolosa Jr., House private prosecutor and legal spokesperson, stressed that point in a prosecution statement issued on Thursday, adding that the rebuttal would serve “no adjudicative purpose whatsoever.” House private prosecutor and legal spokesperson Atty. Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. rejected the proposed middle ground of allowing Duterte’s lawyers to answer evidence already presented under the abandoned charges despite […]...
